user.title: Add a PleatView TV
user.description: Enter the address shown on the TV's PleatView setup screen.

zeroconf_confirm.title: PleatView TV found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Set up **{name}** ({host})? Open PleatView on the TV to see its PIN.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Enter the 6-digit PIN shown on the TV. Open PleatView on the TV if it isn't visible; the PIN is also in its menu (press Back).

dashboard_auth.title: How should {name} sign in?
dashboard_auth.description: The TV needs to sign in to Home Assistant to show dashboards.

menu_options.auth_managed: Create a user for this TV (recommended)
menu_options.auth_token: Use a long-lived access token I created
menu_options.auth_none: Don't sign in from here (sign in on the TV instead)

auth_managed.title: Dedicated user
auth_managed.description: Home Assistant creates a local-only user for this TV and gives it a long-lived access token. Deleting this integration also deletes the user.

data.allow_control: Allow controlling devices from the TV

data_description.allow_control: Turn off for a read-only display: dashboards still update, but buttons on the TV can't change anything.

auth_token.title: Long-lived access token
auth_token.description: Create a token in your Home Assistant profile (Security tab) and paste it here. Dashboards appear as that user sees them.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the TV. Check the address and that PleatView is open.
error.invalid_pin: That PIN doesn't match the one on the TV.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong PINs. Wait a minute and use the new PIN on the TV.
error.invalid_ha_token: Home Assistant doesn't recognise this token.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The discovered device didn't identify itself.

data.ha_url: Home Assistant URL for the TV
data.launch_on_boot: Open PleatView when the TV starts

data_description.ha_url: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's internal URL.
data_description.home_dashboard: Path such as /lovelace/0. Empty uses the first dashboard below, or your default dashboard.
data_description.dashboards: One per line as "Title = /path". Empty lists every dashboard. Used as sources, for rotation and channel up/down on the remote.
data_description.zoom: Below 100% fits more cards on screen.
data_description.return_home_minutes: After someone browses with the remote. 0 never returns.
data_description.reload_minutes: A periodic full reload clears memory on long-running displays. 0 never reloads.
data_description.launch_on_boot: Needs the "Display over other apps" permission on the TV.

error.invalid_url: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.

show_dashboard.name: Show dashboard
show_dashboard.description: Shows a dashboard on the TV.

path.name: Path
path.description: Dashboard path, such as /lovelace/cameras, or a full URL.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Return to the home dashboard after this many seconds. Empty or 0 stays.

show_url.name: Show web page
show_url.description: Opens a web page on top of the dashboard.

size.name: Size
size.description: Picture-in-picture width as a percentage of the screen.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Close after this many seconds. Empty or 0 stays until stopped.

show_camera.name: Show camera
show_camera.description: Shows a camera's live stream, by default as picture-in-picture over the dashboard.

size.name: Size
size.description: Picture-in-picture width as a percentage of the screen.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Close after this many seconds. Empty or 0 stays until stopped.

title.name: Title
title.description: Shown in Home Assistant while the stream plays. Defaults to the camera name.

notify.name: Show notification
notify.description: Shows a notification card on the TV, also over other apps when PleatView may draw overlays.

image.name: Image
image.description: Image URL, Home Assistant path (/local/…) or media-source ID.

camera.name: Camera snapshot
camera.description: Attach a current snapshot from this camera.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds before the card disappears. Defaults to 10.

home.name: Go home
home.description: Stops media, closes overlays and shows the home dashboard.
